## Summary

Shenzhen Four Seas Global Link Network Technology is a Shenzhen wireless-network equipment manufacturer dating from July 2009, with its own factory and research and development team, whose core brand is COMFAST [2]. Its range covers wireless and PCIe adapters, repeaters, access points, CPE bridges, Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 7 mesh and 4G/5G routers [2]. The IEEE registry lists three MA-L blocks under "Shenzhen Four Seas Global Link Network Technology Co., Ltd." and one under the "Co.,Ltd" spelling, all in Longhua District, Shenzhen [1].

A MAC in these blocks is most likely a COMFAST product, very often a USB Wi-Fi adapter plugged into someone else's computer. DeviWiki lists COMFAST adapters on Realtek (RTL8811CU, RTL8812AU, RTL8814AU, RTL8192EU, RTL8188 series), MediaTek (MT7612U, MT7601U, MT7628A) and Ralink (RT3070L, RT5370) chips, with FCC IDs under the OYR prefix [3]; an FCC ID's first three or five characters are the grantee code [4].

Randomization depends on the host operating system and is not documented. No security advisory naming the company or COMFAST was found. The company's own site did not respond to fetches from this session.
